church_state_tradeoff.why: 'Separate' and 'support and reflect religion' had no examples.
church_state_tradeoff.scope: Government at every level, in things like prayers before city council meetings, nativity scenes or the Ten Commandments on public property, “In God We Trust” on money, and public money for religious schools and charities.

faith_based_laws.why: No example of a law based on religious teaching.
faith_based_laws.scope: Lawmakers of any faith, voting on issues like abortion, marriage, the death penalty, immigration or aid to the poor.
